title: Engine adapter: Von (395M ModernBERT, von-sdk)
description: Apache-2.0, probabilities per option, runs on MPS, CPU, CUDA and ROCm via the von-sdk package. Closest sibling to Laya; first candidate.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Feature: Engine adapter: Von answers a scored task

Scenario: Von, the closest sibling to Laya, returns option probabilities
  Given the Von (395M ModernBERT, Apache-2.0) model installed via von-sdk on MPS, CPU, CUDA or ROCm
  When I run bd run --engine von on a committed task
  Then it returns a probability per option for every item and studies/ records the answers in the same schema as Laya

right_now_summary: The Von engine adapter now returns option probabilities and records answers across supported hardware.
